name: Japan map: a newly founded city takes a name from its own house's pool

steps.code: BuildHeadlessGameSetup(); g_GameParameters:FullRefresh(); if GameConfiguration.GetRuleSet()~='RULESET_JAC_BANSEIKI' then error('wrong ruleset after refresh') end; HideGameSetup(); return 'headless setup refreshed'

condition.code: local n=0; for _,p in ipairs(PlayerManager.GetAliveMajors()) do n=n+p:GetCities():GetCount() end; return n>=56

steps.code: --[[ Found one city per house the way the Tuner does (Base/Assets/UI/Tuner/TunerMapPanel.lua:111-121, player:GetCities():Create(x,y)). Create returns nil on an invalid plot, so candidates follow the placement rules: land, passable (no mountain), not a city or natural wonder, unowned or owned by the house, and farther than CITY_MIN_RANGE from every city; they are tried nearest-first from the house capital. ]] local rng=GameInfo.GlobalParameters['CITY_MIN_RANGE']; local minD=((rng and tonumber(rng.Value)) or 3)+1; local R=12; local tries=25; local cities={}; for _,p in ipairs(PlayerManager.GetAliveMajors()) do for _,c in p:GetCities():Members() do cities[#cities+1]={c:GetX(),c:GetY()} end end; local function ok(pl,id) if pl:IsWater() or pl:IsImpassable() or pl:IsCity() or pl:IsNaturalWonder() then return false end; local o=pl:GetOwner(); if o~=-1 and o~=id then return false end; for _,xy in ipairs(cities) do if Map.GetPlotDistance(pl:GetX(),pl:GetY(),xy[1],xy[2])<minD then return false end end; return true end; local function candidates(cap,id) local list={}; for i=0,Map.GetPlotCount()-1 do local pl=Map.GetPlotByIndex(i); local d=Map.GetPlotDistance(cap:GetX(),cap:GetY(),pl:GetX(),pl:GetY()); if d<=R and ok(pl,id) then list[#list+1]={d,i,pl} end end; table.sort(list,function(a,b) if a[1]~=b[1] then return a[1]<b[1] end; return a[2]<b[2] end); return list end; local n=0; local skipped={}; for _,p in ipairs(PlayerManager.GetAliveMajors()) do local id=p:GetID(); local civ=PlayerConfigurations[id]:GetCivilizationTypeName(); local pool={}; for row in GameInfo.CityNames() do if row.CivilizationType==civ and row.SortIndex>=0 then pool[row.CityName]=true end end; local cap=p:GetCities():GetCapitalCity(); local c,target; if cap then for k,cand in ipairs(candidates(cap,id)) do if k>tries then break end; c=p:GetCities():Create(cand[3]:GetX(),cand[3]:GetY()); if c then target=cand[3]; break end end end; if not c then skipped[#skipped+1]=civ; print('[JAC_HOUSE_CITY_NAMES] skip civ='..civ..' reason='..(cap and ('no plot within '..R..' of the capital accepted Create') or 'no capital')) else local name=c:GetName(); print('[JAC_HOUSE_CITY_NAMES] civ='..civ..' plot='..target:GetIndex()..' owner='..target:GetOwner()..' name='..tostring(name)..' text='..Locale.Lookup(name)); if not pool[name] or string.sub(name,1,17)~='LOC_JAC_CITYNAME_' then error(civ..' founded '..tostring(name)..', not a name from its own pool or the shared province list') end; cities[#cities+1]={c:GetX(),c:GetY()}; n=n+1 end end; if n<20 then error('expected at least 20 houses checked, got '..n..' (skipped: '..table.concat(skipped,',')..')') end; return 'house names: '..n..' checked, skipped: '..(#skipped>0 and table.concat(skipped,',') or 'none')
